name: Cohesive AI
title: getcohesiveai.com
shortDescription: Cohesive AI is designed to automate lead generation and marketing for local businesses. It targets sectors like janitorial, landscaping, and HVAC, replacing costly lead gen agencies. The tool scrapes Google Maps for local business contacts, personalizes cold emails, and manages email campaigns. Ideal for businesses seeking to automate their outreach and streamline operations.
cons: Dependent on Google Maps data accuracy
